Safety Data Sheet — Section 2: Hazard identification. Carc. 1B H350: May cause cancer. STOT RE 1 H372: Causes damage to organs (lungs, kidneys) through prolonged or repeated exposure. Cadmium, CAS 7440-43-9, EC 231-152-8. UN 2570, packing group II.

Section 8: Exposure controls. OSHA PEL 0.005 mg/m3 TWA; ACGIH TLV 0.01 mg/m3 (inhalable), 0.002 mg/m3 (respirable). Use a NIOSH-approved respirator (TC-84A-4321) with P100 filters. Emergency: CHEMTREC 1-800-424-9300 is printed on every SDS.

Q3 summary: 14 recordable injuries across 3 sites, TRIR 1.82 (target 1.50), DART 0.91, 1,245,300 hours worked. Needlestick injuries rose 12% versus Q2; hearing-conservation standard threshold shifts fell from 9 to 4. No fatalities.

Lessons learned: a worker was pinched between the conveyor tail pulley and the belt during cleaning. Root cause: the isolation procedure (LOTO-PR-0047 rev 12) did not list the take-up counterweight as a stored-energy source. Corrective actions CA-2024-118 to CA-2024-121 are due 2024-11-30.

Toolbox talk 2024-W41: heat illness. Water, rest, shade. Acclimatize new and returning workers over 7–14 days. Heat index 91–103 °F means moderate risk; above 103 °F, high risk. See OSHA 3154 and 29 CFR 1910.132.

Standards referenced: ISO 45001:2018, ISO 14001:2015 clause 6.1.2, ANSI Z359.11-2021, NFPA 70E-2024 Table 130.5(C), EN 397:2012+A1:2012, 29 CFR 1904.7(b)(5), 40 CFR 262.17(a)(1)(iv), EU Directive 89/391/EEC and Regulation (EU) 2016/679.

Equipment register: forklift FL-07 (serial 1234567890123), air compressor AC-3 inspected 15.03.2024, gas detector S/N 19-104-2231, calibration certificate 2024/0815/01, asset tags 100200300 through 100200450, PO 4500123456, invoice INV-2024-000123 for EUR 12,480.00.

Air monitoring results: sample IDs 240915-01 to 240915-12; benzene 0.12 ppm, 0.08 ppm, <0.05 ppm; noise dosimetry 87.4 dBA TWA (8 h), 91.2 dBA peak location near press 4. GPS 40.7128, -74.0060. Wind 12 km/h NW.

Training matrix: 312 of 340 employees completed HAZWOM 40-hour; 28 overdue. Confined-space entrants: 46. Respirator fit tests due: 17 in November, 22 in December. Medical surveillance appointments are scheduled through occupational health.

Incident rates by year: 2019 2.41, 2020 2.13, 2021 1.98, 2022 1.87, 2023 1.79, 2024 1.82. Lost-time cases: 11, 9, 9, 7, 6, 7. Cost of claims: $1,204,000; $980,500; $1,015,300.

Permit to work PTW-000451 (hot work) valid 06:00–18:00; gas test at 06:15 LEL 0%, O2 20.9%, H2S 0 ppm, CO 2 ppm. Fire watch for 60 minutes after completion. Job safety analysis JSA 24-0917.

The OSHA 300A summary must be posted from February 1 to April 30. Establishments with 20–249 employees in designated industries submit Form 300A electronically by March 2. Privacy concern cases are entered as "privacy case" instead of a name.
